subject: part
title: PART.-----ALT.F.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 437 (MP(I)-11). PART (participation) is the subject; ALT-F (alternative functionalism) is the partner. From the subject: ACT (activism), IST-ACT (isolated activism) and CULT-TF-S. From ACT: OMT-DY. From IST-ACT: POL-CON (political consciousness). From CULT-TF-S: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From OMT-DY: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From SOC-RT-DY: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From LK-IMP: TRS (transition). From INTR: OBS (observation).
